sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Central Government may, by notification, amend the Schedules, and the amendment has effect as if enacted in the Act.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: An amendment to a Schedule is laid before Parliament. It cannot amend a section. Schedule V on managerial remuneration is the most-used example.
